children: Shares of Beta Bionics slipped after the medical devices company said it proposed a $125 million underwritten public offering.
The stock declined 5.1%, to $18.25, in after-hours trading Tuesday, after closing up 15%. Through the close, shares were still down 37% this year.
The company said it would use the proceeds of the offering for general corporate purposes, which could include costs associated with commercializing its tubeless insulin patch pump Mint.

Mint-related expenses could include expanding manufacturing sites, increasing research and development, investing in product enhancements and taking advantage of potential strategic opportunities, Beta Bionics said.
The company plans to grant the underwriters of the offering a 30-day option to buy up to an additional $18.75 million.
